mapper.select: SELECT event_sequence,event_id,event_type,business_id,sender_id,entity_id,payload,occurred_date FROM event_outbox WHERE business_id=#{businessId} AND acknowledged_date IS NULL AND (lease_expire_date IS NULL OR lease_expire_date<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ORDER BY event_sequence LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE event_outbox SET lease_token=#{lease.token},consumer_id=#{lease.consumerId},lease_expire_date=#{lease.until},delivery_count=delivery_count+1 WHERE event_sequence IN #{id}
UPDATE event_outbox SET acknowledged_date=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE acknowledged_date IS NULL AND event_sequence IN #{id}
UPDATE event_outbox SET acknowledged_date=NULL,lease_token=NULL,consumer_id=NULL,lease_expire_date=NULL WHERE business_id=#{businessId} AND event_sequence IN #{id}
